text:

told me:

are you really Charles Bukowski?

and I told her

let's leave that

I don't feel well

and lifted her dress to her neck

To be

again

real

Someone.

translation.title: Someone
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish version attributed to Charles Bukowski. Its fragmented free-verse layout and explicit, violent content are retained.
